original_case: Can unequal selection still recover a total on average?
changed_condition: Now make the last item impossible to sample.
viewer_inference: Known positive inclusion probabilities are essential. And unbiased means right on average, not right in every sample. Our three estimates already showed the variation.
resolution: E[sum I_i y_i/pi_i]=sum y_i for known positive inclusion probabilities. Unbiasedness is not low variance or samplewise exactness.
prerequisite: Operations introduced explicitly in this film
